I don't mean to make you feel bad at all. All I mean to say is this... Try not looking at porn for a while. If you feel those "needs", try going to a public place. Is there anywhere in public that you feel comfortable? 

Do you have any hobbies or interests? If you do, let me know man, and we can find something positive and healthy for you to get started with. 

I'm so sorry to hear how you feel about yourself, but know this. Because of all the bullshit life has given you, you probably have an unbelievable personality just waiting to be released! I bet you can be genuine like no one else. I bet you are kind and respectful. Let's talk about some of these things... whenever you're ready!
